descmd: This ballot version of the ePI Implementation Guide is published for public comment through the January 2027 HL7 balloting cycle. For a detailed list of the changes in this version, see the [Change Notes](http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/emedicinal-product-info/2.0.0-202701-ballot/changes.html).
